en: This is a black and white postcard image, depicting an ornate, domed building (palace or cathedral) with elaborate stone architecture and statues. There are horse-drawn carriages and groups of people in early 20th-century attire visible in the street. Several large lampposts and statues are featured prominently in the foreground. The street is wide, and a monumental gate or portal is visible further back.
